name.evidence: p1 red label: 'CASE NO. 360 NORTHERN DISTRICT / RIO de JESUS MARIA GRANT'; transcript title p (PDF p5) 'for the place named "Rio de Jesus Maria"'

year.evidence: Petition PDF p15 (transcript p9): 'That on the 13 day of October A.D. 1843 Manuel Micheltorena Governor of California ... granted to Tomas M. Hardy ... the tract of land called Rio de Jesus Maria'

governor.evidence: Petition PDF p15 (transcript p9): 'Manuel Micheltorena Governor of California by virtue of authority in him vested granted...'

grantee.evidence: Petition PDF p15 names ORIGINAL grantee as 'Tomas M. Hardy called also Tomas Hardy'. James M. Harbin is a claimant/purchaser: PDF p16-17 (transcript p10-11) show Hardy died intestate 1848, tract sold by probate to petitioners Harbin, Estell, Tyler, Parrish; Tyler then conveyed to Harbin. Hoffman 'Tomas Hardy' agrees against the register.

land_case.evidence: p1 red label 'CASE NO. 360 NORTHERN DISTRICT'; PDF filename cubanc_lcf_nd360.pdf; page stamps '360 ND'

outcome.evidence: Docket PDF p13 (transcript p8): 'July 26 1855 ... Commissioner S.B. Farwell delivered the opinion of the Board confirming the claim (vide page 227)'. Board confirmation verified; register 'Confirmed' consistent. Hoffman 1862 also 'confirmed'.

corrections.grantee: Original grantee = Tomas M. Hardy (also Tomas Hardy), per grant decree/petition PDF p15: 'granted to Tomas M. Hardy called also Tomas Hardy the tract of land called Rio de Jesus Maria'. Register's 'James M. Harbin' is the American claimant/purchaser, not the grantee.

notes: 230 pgs stated (PDF p2). Grant date Oct 13 1843, Micheltorena, to Thomas M. Hardy; both confirmed by the sworn petition and by Vallejo's deposition (PDF p17: 'granted to Tomas Hardy in 1843 or 1844'). No patent copy in pages read; patent fields left null for Phase C (GLO patent no. 86 claimed).
